user.title: OnOff - Zing Updater
user.description:
Choose the release channel and the Zing packages to install (Zing Music, the Zing card and the OnOff Licenser).

You can install more later, or switch channel, with **Configure** on the integration.

data_description.channel: Stable installs normal releases. Beta also installs pre-releases with the newest features; switch back to Stable any time (you stay on your version until a newer stable release is out).
data_description.packages: Each package is labelled with its type (Integration or Card) and installs to the right place.

reconfigure.title: Install more Zing packages
reconfigure.description: Switch the release channel or install more packages. Packages you already have are ticked; leaving them ticked fetches the newest version for the chosen channel.

setup_restart_required.description:
One or more integrations have been installed by OnOff - Zing Updater. Home Assistant must be restarted for the changes to take effect.
